title: 💬 Weight loss drugs
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
When should weight-loss drugs be considered medical treatment rather than a lifestyle shortcut?
Should these drugs be available to anyone who wants to lose weight, or only to people with specific medical needs?
How might widespread use of weight-loss drugs change society's attitudes toward obesity?
What should happen if a person regains weight after stopping the medication?
Would you use a weight-loss drug if it were effective but needed to be taken for many years?
